thread:
zoe: quick q  can saved route views capture a pinned per-model column? saves currently only keep route filters. thinking of a boolean like `include_model_column: true` in the save payload to toggle rendering.
carlos: yes, infra wants this for rollout audits. makes debugging easier.
jess: UX: if included, do we persist which models are pinned and expansion state? maybe separate concerns: pinned list vs UI expansion.
arun: backend note: POST /api/views currently stores scope+filters. adding `include_model_column` and `pinned_model_ids` should be safe if default false/empty. also need telemetry sampling to match cost previews. propose `telemetry_sample_rate` in the payload.
zoe: sample v2 payload idea:
```json
{
  "v":"2",
  "name":"Checkout - pinned models",
  "scope":{"type":"route","id":"checkout-prod"},
  "filters":[{"field":"status","op":"=","value":"ok"}],
  "include_model_column":true,
  "pinned_model_ids":["mid-991","mid-234"],
  "telemetry_sample_rate":0.02
}
```
jess: questions: 1) use immutable model ids (yes). 2) if a pinned id disappears, show grey "missing" row with last-known stats?
infra-bot: reminder: rolling canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC. adding schema fields requires a minor DB migration + compatibility guard.
arun: migration plan: add `view_schema_version` int default=1. writers accept v2; readers only render model column when schema_version>=2. also cap pinned_model_ids length to 10 server-side.
carlos: security: pinned model metadata could leak across org-shared views. ensure we only show metadata if requester has model-read permission; otherwise show id-only placeholder.
zoe: docs note: update POST /api/views contract. response should include `stored_view_id` and `schema_version`.
jess: I'll mock the save modal flow and placeholder UI states and share the figma link.
arun: tests: migration default v1, v2 write/read roundtrip, telemetry_sample_rate flows into cost preview calc.
zoe: I'll open RFC and API PR today. thanks all. :rocket:
